descriptions.notStarted: I see Jacob, the garden caretaker over there! Why does he look so worried? Maybe I can lend him a hand.
descriptions.inProgress: I talked with Jacob, who's trying to expand his garden. He's sent me to gather #b25 Cherry Blossom seeds#k, #b10 Silk Feathers#k and #b10 Leather#k. I've heard that Sakura celions might have the blossom seeds. In return for this, he's agreed to give me some high-quality potions. I bet they taste delicious...
descriptions.completed: I got the materials that Jacob needed to expand the garden. He mentioned he might have more work for me if I needed it. I'll pay him a visit soon!
